summary: Class 7 ICSE Biology Topic 08: Human Nervous System & Reflex Arc in the warm editorial aesthetic (#fbfaf7 ivory canvas, Newsreader serif, rich black #161514). Features Central (CNS) vs Peripheral (PNS) divisions, microscopic neuron anatomy (Cyton, Axon, Dendrites, Myelin Sheath, Synapse), Cerebrum vs Cerebellum vs Medulla Oblongata functions, and the 5-component Reflex Arc pathway. Zero SVGs.
